name: DPN AI Release Gates v7
description: Strict release-candidate validation for DPN AI v7. A candidate is not releasable unless all required tests, security, runtime, dependency, secret, permission, artifact, version, and release-note gates pass for the exact head commit.
instructions: Validate the exact candidate head; never reuse stale green evidence from an older head.
Treat missing or unknown required gate state as a release blocker.
Block release on any failed required test, version mismatch, critical/high security finding, unresolved blocker, weakened test, or weakened security control.
Require artifact integrity and release-note evidence before release readiness.
Never merge merely because implementation is feature-complete; release gates must pass.
Merge still requires explicit operator authorization even after all gates pass.
